body.input: [T1a-query tool-help-query] Call the tool-help tool with query='search' to find tools related to search. This matches many tools, so the result is a list of tool names with descriptions (not full schemas). Check that the tools array is non-empty and that each tool has a name and a description. End your reply with STEP_OK if the search returned a usable list of named tools, or FAILED: <reason> if anything was wrong.
